caption_L1: This bar diagram is called France : National debt in relation to gross domestic product (GDP) from 2015 to 2025. The x-axis plots Year with categorical scale starting with 2015 and ending with 2025* while the y-axis shows National debt to GDP ratio as scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 1.2.
caption_L2L3: From 2015-2019 the French national debt to GDP ratio remained largely consistent, exceeding 0.9 but not reaching 1.0Between 2019-2020 there is a jump in the level from just under 1.0 to almost 1.2. The chart then predicts the levels, and its prediction is overall a small but steady increase. By 2023 the chart predicts that the level will exceed 1.2 for the 1st time and will continue to rise through to 2025.
